children: The drop came as benchmark mortgage rates rose sharply, with the 30‑year fixed rate hitting a 15-month high of 6.58%, amid high energy prices, elevated debt supply, and widening deficits.
Applications to refinance a mortgage, which are typically more sensitive to short‑term interest rate moves, fell by 6% week-on-week, while applications to purchase a home were broadly flat.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
